text: “But----I suspect you do like Valborg. Oh, I don't mean in any wrong way. But you're young; you don't know what an innocent liking might drift into. You always pretend to be so sophisticated and all, but you're a baby. Just because you are so innocent, you don't know what evil thoughts may lurk in that fellow's brain.” “You don't suppose Valborg could actually think about making love to me?” Her rather cheap sport ended abruptly as Vida cried, with contorted face, “What do you know about the thoughts in hearts?
